dedupe_keys.name: ceap chinese power plant air pollution emissions

description: CEAP provides air-pollution information for Chinese power plants based on the continuous emission monitoring systems network. The research team publishes plant-level absolute emissions, fuel use, generating capacity and geographic locations. The current Figshare collection contains three CSV deposits covering 2014–2017: absolute emissions, stack-gas concentrations and summary descriptions. All three are freely available under CC BY 4.0. The public own pages identify these contents and years but do not expose a common time step for every table, so a uniform sampling frequency is not assumed. The data can parameterize pollution consequences of electricity-generation and capacity-planning scenarios, complementing network and demand records such as data-re-europe. A caveat is that this derived inventory is not the full raw continuous-monitoring stream. Operating changes after 2017 and unreported differences in monitoring coverage require attention when applying it to later scenarios. The CSV payloads were not downloaded or checked against underlying monitoring observations.
